name: wiki-forge
description: Turn your AI agent into a knowledge compiler. Feed sources once, build a persistent cross-referenced wiki that compounds over time. Ships eighteen skills (ask, capture, ingest, crystallize, query, graph, summarize, trace, corroborate, resolve-contradictions, lint, scale-audit, log, overview, triage, retract, stub, init) and four subagents (ingestor, librarian, linter, curator), plus hybrid BM25+semantic search, split indices, contradiction tracking, typed cross-references, graph analysis with user-facing path/neighbor/subgraph queries, topic-coverage reports (five-section audit via two-shape retrieval), a natural-language read-side router (/wiki-ask) that classifies a plain-English question and dispatches to the right read skill, claim-level provenance (quote-level /wiki-trace, opt-in claim-ID anchors, and an evidence-chain cascade-review lint), crystallization (the fourth canonical operation — merge a filed synthesis's atomic facts back into their existing concept/entity pages with trace-determined provenance), tier-classified WebSearch corroboration of the verify queue with closed-loop verify-clearing at the ingestor's takeaway gate plus a sibling contradiction-resolution flow, structured telemetry (7 JSONLs covering ingest/query/lint/overview/source-freshness/corroborate/contradiction), pre-write secret scanning, content-drift polling, per-domain URL classification with stdlib raw-HTML metadata extraction (OG / JSON-LD / article:tag / arXiv citation_*) for capture-side source_tags parity with browser-clipper onramps and four-tier credibility classification (vendor/named-pub/community/denylist) for /wiki-corroborate's open-web search-and-surface flow, and a recurring scale-breakdown audit probe runner with five hard re-audit triggers for early detection of authoring-side scaling failure modes. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
